subject: new to shinyapps - error when calling setAccountInfo()

messages.author: 39f5a1aeeec9eadd
messages.subject: new to shinyapps - error when calling setAccountInfo()
parts:
Hi all. I seem to have set everything up properly, but I can't quite figure out why I am getting an error. I run the following code:

setAccountInfo(name = "nutwition", token = "***********", secret = "****************")

which I copied from the very convenient copy button, provided in the "Tokens" section of the my.shinyapps.io web interface. R returns the following error, which I was not able to find in past group posts here:

Error: /v1/users/10111/accounts?count=100&offset=0 405 - Method Not Allowed

The only thing I could figure is that I do not have an app named "nutwition" in the "Apps" section of the my.shinyapps.io web interface. I would suppose that I need to add "nutwition" to that list, but I don't see where to do that.

any ideas on what is happening with this setAccountInfo() call here?

Thank you,
Dan
